title: Kulan Assistant
description: Private writing help for selected text, summaries in Files, Translate and Explain after Live Text, and search with questions. Runs on this computer
size: about 40 MB, plus a model of 1.8 to 5 GB
note: Choose and download a model in Kulan Settings > Assistant.

title: Office and media apps
description: LibreOffice Writer, Calc and Impress, VLC and GIMP

title: Developer Kit
description: Git, Python with pip and virtual environments, build tools, Docker and Docker Compose, curl
note: To use Docker without sudo, run: sudo usermod -aG docker $USER, then sign out and in again.

title: Virus scanner
description: ClamAV with a simple app (ClamTk) to scan files, folders and USB drives on demand, useful for files from Windows computers

title: Phone Link
description: Connect your Android phone: notifications, texts, shared clipboard, files and media controls (GSConnect, works with the KDE Connect app)
note: Install KDE Connect on your phone. After you log out and back in, pair it from Phone Link in the top bar.

title: Nearby Share
description: Send files to nearby phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi, like AirDrop (LocalSend: iPhone, Android, Mac and Windows)
note: Install LocalSend on your other devices too, then open it on both.
